JOURNEY COMPLETE

One measurement.
Four angles.

You used a map, a drawing, and two rules.

01 / LINEAR PAIRS

Share one arm.
Add up to 180°.

Adjacent angles. The outer arms make a straight line.

02 / VERTICALLY OPPOSITE

Share no arm.
Equal.

Two straight lines cross. Vertically opposite angles share no arm. They are equal.
